title: James and John Ask for Places of Honor
description: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, ask Jesus to let them sit at his right and left hands in his glory. Jesus answers that they do not know what they are asking, and asks if they can drink the cup he drinks and be baptized with the baptism he is baptized with. When the other ten disciples become angry, Jesus teaches them that whoever wants to be great in God's kingdom must be a servant, just as the Son of Man came to serve and give his life as a ransom for many.
